usage: The word '樓上' refers to the upper floor or upstairs area of a building.
It can be used to indicate location when describing where something is happening or located.
It often functions as a noun but can also be part of prepositional phrases to show direction or position.
In conversation, it's common to say '去樓上' (go upstairs) or '樓上有咩？' (What's upstairs?).
It can be contrasted with '樓下' (downstairs) to describe different floors.
